title: Cascade Bridge Adapter manifest
description: The Bridge-facing manifest of an adapter package (adapter.yaml), in the shape sketched by section 6 of the Cascade Bridge RFC, the-cascade-protocol/spec#43. This schema is the seed of the Bridge specification's manifest schema and moves to a bridge-spec repository unchanged when one exists. Paths are relative to the adapter's root directory.

id.description: The format id a Bridge routes on. The same string cascade-cli accepts for --from.

name.description: Human name of the source format.

version.description: Version of this adapter package (semantic versioning).

licence.description: SPDX licence identifier of the adapter package itself. Licences of data the package carries are recorded per file in fixtures/ro-crate-metadata.json.

bridge-spec.description: The Bridge specification version this adapter is written against. While no numbered specification exists, the RFC that stands in for it.

tier.description: RFC section 9. universal: no code, Core only, runs on every conforming Bridge. limited: names the Bridges and profiles it binds to, and the code components it carries.

vocabularies.description: The Cascade vocabularies the adapter writes, and the spec revision they are pinned to. The same pin conformance/scripts/SPEC_PIN carries.

repo.description: Repository the pinned commit is on, as owner/name.

commit.description: Full SHA of the pinned spec revision.

versions.description: Vocabulary name to version, as spec/VOCAB_VERSIONS records them; pre-stable drafts are named by their draft label.

source.description: What the source format looks like to a Bridge's read stage.

media-type.description: IANA media type of the source documents.

schema.description: The pinned source-side schema (XSD, JSON Schema, Schematron) a Bridge validates every unit against.

envelopes.description: The document roots the source format arrives in. A Bridge accepts any of them and splits each on `unit`.

root.description: Local name of the document element.

schema.description: A schema that validates a whole document in this envelope, when the pinned schema alone does not declare its root.

unit.description: The element a Bridge splits a document on and hands to the mapping one at a time (Enterprise Integration Patterns: Splitter). The unit's raw bytes are preserved.

detect.description: The rule a Bridge's content-based router applies to decide this adapter handles an input.

root-element.description: The input's document element is one of these.

contains.description: And the document contains at least one of this element.

profiles-required.description: Optional Bridge profiles (RFC section 9) the adapter needs beyond Core: for example xslt-3, sparql-construct, streaming.

in.description: Source to Cascade RDF. Absent until the first mapping is written.

out.description: Cascade RDF to source. Absent means import-only.

tables.description: Tables a mapping reads, each with its source and licence.

source.description: Where the table's rows came from.

vocab.description: Extension vocabulary files in the adapter's own namespace, for values that have no Cascade term.

fixtures.description: The cases file a Bridge's harness executes; see cases.schema.json.

path.description: A path relative to the adapter root, with forward slashes.

mapping.description: One entry per mapping language the direction is written in.

modules.description: Stylesheets the entry includes or imports, listed so the package is enumerable.

findings.description: The stylesheet, or secondary result document, that writes the findings sidecar.

entry.description: The CONSTRUCT query, or the file listing them in order, run over the Bridge's generic lift of the source.

lift.description: Which lift vocabulary the queries expect (for example xml).
